sources.title: T3 Model Architecture | resemble-ai/chatterbox | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The T3 model implements a token-to-token approach where text tokens are transformed into speech tokens through a large language model backbone. The architecture supports both English-only and multilingual configurations with sophisticated conditioning mechanisms for voice characteristics and alignment-informed inference for quality control.
